summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing a share buyback program. On 28 April 2026, it repurchased 428,598 ordinary shares (5p each) at an average price of 11.1858 GBP per share (range 11.1250–11.2850), totaling ~4.8M GBP. The repurchase was conducted via JP Morgan Securities plc under authority granted at the 2025 AGM and announced 6 Jan 2026. Shares will be canceled, reducing issued capital from 2,521,242,327. The buyback is an on-exchange transaction on the LSE and an on-market purchase under Hong Kong rules. This is a routine but open-market capital return program; watch for continued execution and potential EPS accretion.
